context: idle / ready with the hammer held up (the master art pose)
anticipation dip before a heavy overhead strike
lifting a heavy tool overhead (elbow extending)
top of the wind-up: weight on the back foot, hammer dropped behind the head
mid swing: elbow leads, shoulder raised, hips forward
impact of a heavy downward strike: arm nearly straight, weight on the front leg
recovery: the hammer hangs, momentum carried
a step with the front foot, weight transferring forward
NEGATIVE example: pelvis lifted beyond the legs' reach (must fail)
